title: Finite free actual geometric fibres of lisse coefficient modules
statement: Fix ell prime, any scheme X and an algebraically closed geometric point x. For each of the integral coefficient rings O_E, the finite-extension coefficient fields E and the finite-subextension-valued condensed algebraic-closure ring, the predicate FiniteFreeFibre of [def-sfb-lisse-representation-data] holds: every lisse module has an additive fibre isomorphism from a finite free module over the original coefficient ring, intertwining its ordinary scalar multiplication with the specified constant-section scalar action. X need not be connected, Noetherian or normal.

proof.text: Pull a lisse module back to the geometric point. Restrict a finite free trivialization along a section of its covering arrow to obtain a globally free finite-rank module on the point, including rank zero.

Evaluate the finite direct sum at the final object. Finite sums of abelian sheaves are products, and the point coefficient comparison evaluated at the one-point profinite set gives the original scalar ring. It is a ring-object comparison, so it respects the specified constants and their scalar actions. Transport the ordinary finite basis across this comparison and the global trivialization. For the algebraic-closure ring, every element on the one-point test lies in a finite extension, giving precisely the same scalar ring.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_geometric_fibres_finite_free
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) :
    (∀ E, FiniteFreeFibre (integers ell E)
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers ell E) (continuousConstants _) x) ∧
    (∀ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell,
      FiniteFreeFibre (Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E)) E (continuousConstants E) x) ∧
    FiniteFreeFibre (Mon.mk (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ell)) (PadicAlgCl ell)
      (Profinite.PadicAlgCl.constRingHom ell) x
